title: Markus-brand sites must not enumerate Next reader static params (CMS build fails)
description: Pilobol.us CMS Amplify app dv0pdx67fk80m builds fail since scaffold PR #50: generateArticleStaticParams in lib/reader-static-params.ts lists CMS article slugs from GraphQL (now non-empty), but app/articles/[slug]/page.tsx throws MarkusSiteRendererError for Markus brands during prerender. Job 5 (next.12) had no slugs, 5 pages; job 7 (next.15) 15 pages, fails on /articles/believe-the-rainbow. Fix: both static-params generators return [] for Markus brands.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Root cause: `generateArticleStaticParams` (lib/reader-static-params.ts) lists published CMS article slugs via GraphQL for every brand. CMS job 5 (next.12, 5 static pages) had no slugs; job 7 (next.15, 15 pages) found articles and `/articles/[slug]` threw MarkusSiteRendererError for brand pilobol-us. Fix PR: https://github.com/AnthusAI/Papyrus/pull/138 (both generators return [] for Markus).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Duplicate of PPY-dc5273 (created by a first diagnosis agent that lost its brief). Fixed by Papyrus#139 (released in next.16); verified by CMS build job 9 passing.

right_now_summary: Papyrus #139 fixes Markus builds by skipping article static params, and CMS build job 9 now passes.
